notes.title: bug fix.
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug in the canyon scenario (Cars did not spawn on the ground)
- Improved control sensitivity.

notes.title: Achievments and Ranking
notes.content: Added Achievements, stats, global leaderboard and leaderboard with friends.

notes.title: bug fiz!
notes.content:
- Gamepad 100% implemented
- Key bug fixed
- Transit with AI implemented
- Improved difficulty (because it was very easy to earn money)
- implemented damage system

notes.title: Mais desafiante
notes.content:
- Be more careful in traffic. Cars can dodge obstacles and cut you off
- Avoid hitting the cars (I'm serious!!!). If you crash you will have damage deducted from your collected coins.
- You will not collect maneuver bonuses in the air as easily when you are flipping over. ahahahah

notes.title: New even more challenging scenario
